dec-con.lbr:
  Rename pads for THRU-HOLE1 to remove superfluous "2" and correct the description.
  Create "A" variant for THRU_HOLE1 which doesn't zig-zag.
  Fix description of TO39.
  Add an RCA jack that matches what Mouser is carrying.
  Add a DPDT 7209 switch.
  Add a part for the top edge of an Omnibus extender card.
  Add thru-hole PNP and NPN transistors with various footprints.
  Add missing descriptions for 18 and 20 pin .125" grid headers.
  Add missing description for obsolete crystal package.
  Add missing descriptions for DS7545x drivers.
  Add missing description for XC9536-44.
  Add 16-09651 quad pulse transformer.
